title: Potential emergence in LLM agents: a statistical physics perspective
abstract: arXiv:2611.27618v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: There has been significant recent interest in understanding the behaviour of LLM agents from the perspective of human preferences or corpus statistics. In this paper we propose agent states as intermediate variables through which post-training can be measured and predicted. From a statistical physics perspective, we study the emergence of a global potential which governs the transition of state in LLM agent reasoning. We introduce a partition function to model the ideal KL-regularised transition distribution and track potential structure, mean reward and state entropy. We demonstrate our approach in two Qwen3.5-9B tasks: safety-test selection and physics-reasoning auditing. We observe that the potential structure strengthens during post-training as predicted from our framework, while joint changes in reward and state entropy provide consistency evidence. translated_title: 大语言模型智能体中的势能涌现：统计物理学视角
translated_abstract: 近年来，从人类偏好或语料库统计的角度理解大语言模型智能体的行为引起了极大关注。本文提出将智能体状态作为中间变量，通过这些变量可以对后训练过程进行测量和预测。从统计物理学的视角出发，我们研究了一个支配大语言模型智能体推理中状态转移的全局势能的涌现。我们引入配分函数来建模理想的KL正则化转移分布，并追踪势能结构、平均奖励和状态熵。我们在两个Qwen3.5-9B任务上展示了我们的方法：安全测试选择和物理推理审计。我们观察到，正如我们的框架所预测的，势能结构在后训练过程中不断增强，同时奖励与状态熵的联合变化提供了一致性证据。因此，状态为后训练如何组织智能体行为提供了定量描述。
tldr: 该论文从统计物理学视角提出将智能体状态作为中间变量，通过配分函数与全局势能来定量测量并预测大语言模型智能体在后训练过程中行为的组织与涌现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes agent states as intermediate variables and leverages a partition function and global potential from a statistical physics perspective to quantitatively measure and predict how post-training organizes LLM agent behavior.
